As a Business Support Administrator, you are part of Business Support Department. This department is
responsible for vendor/client management, customer service, stock transfer requests, order management,
inbound planning, outbound/trailer planning and new product introduction. The department consist of 18
people. You will report to the Business Support Supervisor

What we offer
- Good salary
- Full time
- Dynamic work environment
- the language in the workplace is English
- Great team with a lot of fun colleagues

Who you are
For the role of Business Support Administrator, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You are available to work 40 hours per week
-  You are available for day shifts
-  You speak English
- You read English
- You write English
- You have customer service skills
-  You are willing to work under pressure
-  You are willing to work in Tilburg

What will you do
As a business support administrator you are there for the customer! You will have a brought variety of tasks, so no day is the same. These tasks are a part of your job discription:

- Owning, logging & ensuring all daily customer services contacts & queries received via telephone & email: Being the voice of the customer
- Auctioning customer complaints received ensuring that detailed and accurate root cause/corrective actions are implemented, formally documented and submitted to the customer
-  Compiling, reviewing and auctioning reporting suites for our key account customers
- Carrier management including tracking open customer orders through to delivery/return/claim and actioning exceptions as they arise
-  Initiate & participate in Customer & Department projects to achieve continue improvements

Where will you work
At this company they are fully committed to the health and safety of their employees!

Get started as an Inbound Warehouse Employee at DHL in Eindhoven and play an important role in the logistics process. You will ensure that incoming goods are received, inspected and processed accurately, so everything ends up in the right place on time. In return for your efforts, you will receive a gross hourly wage of €15.12, shift allowance, travel reimbursement and the opportunity to obtain a contract with the client. Are you ready for a varied logistics role with opportunities to grow? Apply today!

Your responsibilities include:

    - Receiving and inspecting incoming goods
    
- Scanning and processing products in the system
    
- Prepacking orders according to customer specifications
    
- Placing products in the correct warehouse location
    
- Performing internal transport activities
    
- Inspecting damaged or non-conforming goods

What’s in it for you

    - Gross salary of €15.12 per hour
    
- 35% shift allowance after 21:00
    
- Travel reimbursement up to €14.85 per day
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Temporary employment contract through Manpower with the opportunity for a contract with the client
    
- Free access to more than 200 online training courses through the Manpower Academy

    - At least 18 years old due to the nature of the work
    
- Available to work 40 hours per week
    
- Own transportation to travel to the work location
    
- Good command of the Dutch and/or English language
    
- Willingness to perform physical work
    
- Ability to apply for a Certificate of Conduct (VOG)

Are you ready to start working as an Inbound Warehouse Employee in Eindhoven? Don't wait too long. There is currently room for new colleagues, but the number of available positions is limited. Click the apply button and we will contact you as soon as possible.
